facts.text: Orangettes are fine strips of candied orange peel, candied slowly and coated in a thin layer of dark chocolate; chocolatiers sell them as a classic holiday and after dinner sweet, two contrasting tastes, one full bodied, one tangy.

unsourced: How every web page was read: through search result summaries only (WebFetch is refused on this network). Each source says what its summary supported. A refuter with page access should open the pages behind any line that goes on a card.

The French origin of the orangette and the history of the chocolate and orange pairing: searched and not confirmed, so left out.
